name: package.json Validator
description: Validate and format your package.json — check required fields, version syntax and JSON validity with clear error messages.
body:
Validation result

Paste your package.json and click Validate.
howto: Paste your package.json into the input.
The tool checks JSON validity, required fields, version format and dependency syntax.
Each check shows pass, warning or fail with a clear message.
Fix any issues, re-paste and re-validate until it is clean.
features: JSON syntax validation with helpful errors
Checks required fields: name, version, description, main, scripts, license
Flags common issues in dependency names and versions

faq.q: What is a valid semver version?
faq.a: Semantic versioning uses MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH like 1.0.0, optionally with pre-release tags like 1.0.0-beta.1. The tool flags malformed versions.
npm requires at minimum a name and version. This tool also checks description, main, scripts and license and warns if they are missing or unusual.
No. It only validates the file content — it never executes anything.
No. Validation runs entirely in your browser.
